Class ServerInputHandler

java.lang.Object
splendor.network.server.ServerInputHandler
public class ServerInputHandler extends Object
Handles server-side validation and execution of player game actions (taking gems, purchasing cards, reserving cards). Each method returns a result string: "SUCCESS" variants on success, or "ERROR: description" on failure.

    • handleTakeThreeDifferent

      public static String handleTakeThreeDifferent(Player player, GameState gameState, GameRules gameRules, String c1, String c2, String c3)
      Handles a take-three-different-gems action on the server side.
      Parameters:
      player - the player taking gems
      gameState - the current game state
      gameRules - the game rules for validation
      c1 - the first gem color string
      c2 - the second gem color string
      c3 - the third gem color string
      Returns:
      "SUCCESS" or an error message

    • handleReserveCard

      public static String handleReserveCard(Player player, GameState gameState, GameRules gameRules, int level, int number)
      Handles a card reserve action on the server side.
      Parameters:
      player - the player reserving the card
      gameState - the current game state
      gameRules - the game rules for validation
      level - the card level (1, 2, or 3)
      number - the card index (0-3 for visible, 4 for hidden draw)
      Returns:
      "SUCCESS_JOKER", "SUCCESS_NO_JOKER", or an error message

    • handlePurchaseCard

      public static String handlePurchaseCard(Player player, GameState gameState, GameRules gameRules, boolean isReserved, int level, int index)
      Handles a card purchase action on the server side.
      Parameters:
      player - the player purchasing the card
      gameState - the current game state
      gameRules - the game rules for validation
      isReserved - true if purchasing from reserved hand, false if from table
      level - the card level (ignored if isReserved)
      index - the card index
      Returns:
      "SUCCESS" if the purchase succeeded, or an error message
